question: The year is 2022. I am at the National Air and Space Museum east of the Potomac River. I want to go to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF using the metro. I go in the wrong direction and end up at the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. How many metro stations am I away from my original destination if I don't change lines? Your answer should be a numerical integer value.

history.name: WashingtonDCMetroNavigation_Expert
history.content: Plan: Identify the station serving the National Air and Space Museum (likely L'Enfant Plaza or Smithsonian), confirm the destination station as Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport, then find the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. Without changing lines, count the number of stations from that closest station to the airport station. UrbanMapping_Expert, please confirm the precise location of Cleveland Elementary School and its nearest Metro station.

history.name: UrbanMapping_Expert
history.content: Cleveland Elementary School is at 8th St NW & T St NW in Shaw. The closest Metro station is Shaw-Howard University. It is roughly a 7–10 minute walk. U Street/African-Amer Civil War Memorial/Cardozo is slightly farther; thus, Shaw-Howard University is the nearest.

history.name: TransitRouteVerification_Expert
history.content: Using the 2022 WMATA map: If starting at Shaw-Howard University and riding southbound on the Yellow Line without changing lines to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport, the station order is: Shaw-Howard University -> Mt Vernon Sq/7th St-Convention Center -> Gallery Place -> Archives-Navy Memorial-Penn Quarter -> L'Enfant Plaza -> Pentagon -> Pentagon City -> Crystal City -> Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. Excluding the starting station and including the destination, that is 8 stations.

history.name: WashingtonDCMetroNavigation_Expert
history.content: Starting fresh: From the National Air and Space Museum area, we need the closest station to Cleveland Elementary School. Cleveland Elementary is generally associated with the Columbia Heights neighborhood, so the nearest Metro station would be Columbia Heights (Green/Yellow). Without changing lines, traveling on the Yellow Line from Columbia Heights to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport goes: Columbia Heights, U Street, Shaw-Howard University, Mt Vernon Sq/7th St-Convention Center, Gallery Place, Archives-Navy Memorial-Penn Quarter, L'Enfant Plaza, Pentagon, Pentagon City, Crystal City, Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. Counting from Columbia Heights (excluding it) to the airport station (including it) is 10 stations.

history.name: Computer_terminal
history.content: There is no code from the last 1 message for me to execute. If you want to end the conversation, reply only with "TERMINATE".

mistake_reason: At step 3, the agent exhibits Loss of Conversation History (FM-1.4) by "starting fresh" and disregarding the prior confirmed nearest station (Shaw-Howard University). The agent incorrectly re-identifies the closest station as Columbia Heights and assumes uninterrupted Yellow Line service from there, leading to an erroneous 10-station count. This reset ignored previously established facts and constraints, causing the wrong answer.
